raw_entities.title: Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models
raw_entities.content: Defines concepts implicitly via a single non-negative Relation Network energy function E_theta(x, a, w) over entity state trajectories x, attention mask a, and concept code w = [w_x, w_a]. Both concept generation (optimizing x^1) and entity identification (optimizing attention a) are performed at execution time via K=10 steps of Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) over the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z. Meta-training jointly minimizes a softplus contrastive maximum likelihood loss L^ML (estimating the intractable partition function Z via importance sampling) and a sampler KL divergence loss L^KL differentiating through the K-step inner-loop Langevin rollout.

raw_entities.title: Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics
raw_entities.content: Combines Robbins-Monro stochastic gradient optimization with Langevin dynamics by injecting calibrated Gaussian noise omega^k ~ N(0, alpha) into gradient updates of the unnormalized log-posterior or energy function E(x). As step size alpha -> 0 and iteration K -> infinity, Markov chain trajectories sample from the exact Boltzmann posterior distribution p(x) proportional to exp(-E(x))/Z without Metropolis-Hastings accept-reject steps.
raw_entities.key_equation: x^k = x^{k-1} - (alpha / 2) grad_x E(x^{k-1}) + omega^k,  omega^k ~ N(0, alpha)

raw_entities.title: Guided Cost Learning: Deep Inverse Optimal Control
raw_entities.authors: Chelsea Finn, Sergey Levine, Pieter Abbeel
raw_entities.content: Learns neural network cost (energy) functions from expert demonstration trajectories under the Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning Boltzmann model p(x) = exp(-E_theta(x))/Z. Approximates the intractable partition function Z using importance sampling with mixture distribution q(x) = 0.5 p_demo(x) + 0.5 pi(x), while minimizing KL divergence KL(pi || exp(-E_theta)/Z) so the sampling distribution pi generates low-energy negative samples.

raw_entities.title: Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence
raw_entities.content: Approximates intractable log-likelihood gradients of the partition function Z in Boltzmann and energy-based models by running a short K-step Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) or Langevin sampler to draw negative samples x^K. Contrasts positive data energy E(x^0) against negative sample energy E(x^K).

raw_entities.title: Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning

raw_entities.authors: Chelsea Finn, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine
raw_entities.content: Trains meta-parameters theta via end-to-end backpropagation through an execution-time inner-loop gradient descent adaptation procedure. Given few-shot demonstration examples X^demo, K inner-loop gradient steps infer task-adapted parameters w*(X^demo), and the outer meta-objective optimizes theta so adapted parameters generalize on X^train.

raw_entities.title: Concept Acquisition via Meta-Learning from Positive Examples
raw_entities.authors: Erin Grant, Chelsea Finn, Joshua B. Tenenbaum et al.
raw_entities.content: Formulates few-shot Bayesian concept acquisition from positive demonstration examples X^demo as execution-time inner-loop gradient adaptation in MAML. Inferring concept code w* minimizes energy over positive demonstrations while meta-learned prior structure in theta prevents collapse.

raw_entities.title: TextGrad: Automatic Differentiation via Text
raw_entities.authors: Mert Yuksekgonul, Carlos Guestrin, James Zou et al.
raw_entities.content: Generalizes backpropagation and inner-loop gradient descent adaptation to discrete natural-language variables v (prompts, code, or wiki pages). An LLM Critic evaluates a loss or energy rubric and backpropagates natural-language textual gradients grad^{text}_v E explaining how to edit v^{k-1} at execution time across K iterative refinement steps.

raw_entities.title: ProTeGi: Prompt Optimization with Textual Gradients
raw_entities.content: Performs execution-time inner-loop adaptation of natural language instructions using nonparametric textual gradients. An LLM critic diagnoses failure minibatches on demonstration examples and emits natural-language edit critiques that guide iterative semantic gradient descent.

raw_entities.title: A Simple Neural Network Module for Relational Reasoning
raw_entities.authors: Adam Santoro, Peter Battaglia, Timothy Lillicrap et al.
raw_entities.content: Computes pairwise relational interactions g_theta(x_i, x_j, w) across all entity pairs (i, j) gated by attention masks and aggregates them via f_phi. Captures multi-entity compositional, spatial, and graph topology relations where independent unary entity encoders fail.
raw_entities.key_equation: RN(O) = f_phi( sum_{i,j} g_theta(o_i, o_j, q) )

- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.967` — *Promote 'Concept Learning with Energy-B': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.53.*

Both concept generation (optimizing x^1) and entity identification (optimizing attention a) are performed at execution time via K=10 steps of Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) over the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z. Meta-training jointly minimizes a softplus contrastive maximum likelihood loss L^ML (estimating the intractable partition function Z via importance sampling) and a sampler KL divergence loss L^KL differentiating through the K-step inner-loop Langevin rollout.

### [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Max Welling, Yee Whye Teh, 2011)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `x^k = x^{k-1} - (alpha / 2) grad_x E(x^{k-1}) + omega^k,  omega^k ~ N(0, alpha)`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.962` — *Promote 'Bayesian Learning via Stochast': unary=['boltzmann', 'energy', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.51.*

# Execution-Time Inner-Loop & Textual Gradients

> **Compiled via $K$-Step Textual SGLD over Messy KB** | Concept ID: `concept_inner_loop_textgrad`

- **Argument Selection Code ($\mathbf{w}_a$):** Identify KB notes grounded in [gradient, inner_loop, adaptation, energy, metalearning, demonstration] whose contextual formulations co-depend on shared probabilistic or optimization mechanisms (rejecting polysemous noise).

## 1. Filtered & Reconciled Knowledge Base Synthesis

From 10 messy raw documents (including operational logs and polysemous distractors), the Relational Energy Model $E_\theta(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{a}, \mathbf{w})$ isolated **6 coherent documents** while rejecting polysemous traps ():

### [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Igor Mordatch (OpenAI), 2018)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `E_theta(x, a, w) = f_theta(sum_{t,i,j} sigma(a_i)sigma(a_j) g_theta(x_i^t, x_j^t, w), w)^2`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.952` — *Promote 'Concept Learning with Energy-B': unary=['energy', 'gradient', 'inner_loop'], pairwise_synergy=0.37.*
- **Extracted Note:** Defines concepts implicitly via a single non-negative Relation Network energy function E_theta(x, a, w) over entity state trajectories x, attention mask a, and concept code w = [w_x, w_a]. Both concept generation (optimizing x^1) and entity identification (optimizing attention a) are performed at execution time via K=10 steps of Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) over the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z. Meta-training jointly minimizes a softplus contrastive maximum likelihood loss L^ML (estimating the intractable partition function Z via importance sampling) and a sampler KL divergence loss L^KL differentiating through the K-step inner-loop Langevin rollout.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Execution-Time Inner-Loop & Textual Gradients]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]]: Co-instantiates gradient, inner_loop, adaptation, energy.

### [[Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Max Welling, Yee Whye Teh, 2011)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `x^k = x^{k-1} - (alpha / 2) grad_x E(x^{k-1}) + omega^k,  omega^k ~ N(0, alpha)`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.917` — *Promote 'Bayesian Learning via Stochast': unary=['energy', 'gradient', 'noise'], pairwise_synergy=0.16.*
- **Extracted Note:** Combines Robbins-Monro stochastic gradient optimization with Langevin dynamics by injecting calibrated Gaussian noise omega^k ~ N(0, alpha) into gradient updates of the unnormalized log-posterior or energy function E(x). As step size alpha -> 0 and iteration K -> infinity, Markov chain trajectories sample from the exact Boltzmann posterior distribution p(x) proportional to exp(-E(x))/Z without Metropolis-Hastings accept-reject steps.

### [[Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation (MAML)]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Chelsea Finn, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine, 2017)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `min_theta L(theta - alpha grad_theta L_demo(theta))`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.956` — *Promote 'Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning f': unary=['adaptation', 'demonstration', 'gradient'], pairwise_synergy=0.41.*
- **Extracted Note:** Trains meta-parameters theta via end-to-end backpropagation through an execution-time inner-loop gradient descent adaptation procedure. Given few-shot demonstration examples X^demo, K inner-loop gradient steps infer task-adapted parameters w*(X^demo), and the outer meta-objective optimizes theta so adapted parameters generalize on X^train.

# Pairwise Relational & Compositional Architectures

> **Compiled via $K$-Step Textual SGLD over Messy KB** | Concept ID: `concept_relational_reasoning`

- **Argument Selection Code ($\mathbf{w}_a$):** Identify papers modeling pairwise entity interactions g_theta(x_i, x_j, w) gated by attention.
- **Relational Synthesis Code ($\mathbf{w}_x$):** Synthesize pairwise relation networks and entity-gated energy models via [[wiki-links]].
- **Discovered Mechanisms:** `relational`, `pairwise`, `attention`, `compositional`

## 1. Filtered & Reconciled Knowledge Base Synthesis

From 10 messy raw documents (including operational logs and polysemous distractors), the Relational Energy Model $E_\theta(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{a}, \mathbf{w})$ isolated **2 coherent documents** while rejecting polysemous traps ():

### [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Igor Mordatch (OpenAI), 2018)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `E_theta(x, a, w) = f_theta(sum_{t,i,j} sigma(a_i)sigma(a_j) g_theta(x_i^t, x_j^t, w), w)^2`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.959` — *Promote 'Concept Learning with Energy-B': unary=['attention', 'entity', 'g_theta'], pairwise_synergy=0.41.*
- **Extracted Note:** Defines concepts implicitly via a single non-negative Relation Network energy function E_theta(x, a, w) over entity state trajectories x, attention mask a, and concept code w = [w_x, w_a]. Both concept generation (optimizing x^1) and entity identification (optimizing attention a) are performed at execution time via K=10 steps of Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) over the Boltzmann distribution exp(-E_theta)/Z. Meta-training jointly minimizes a softplus contrastive maximum likelihood loss L^ML (estimating the intractable partition function Z via importance sampling) and a sampler KL divergence loss L^KL differentiating through the K-step inner-loop Langevin rollout.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Pairwise Relational & Compositional Architectures]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[A Simple Neural Network Module for Relational Reasoning]]: Co-instantiates relational, pairwise, attention, compositional.

### [[A Simple Neural Network Module for Relational Reasoning]] `[RESEARCH_NOTE]` (Adam Santoro, Peter Battaglia, Timothy Lillicrap et al., 2017)
- **Formula / Mechanism:** `RN(O) = f_phi( sum_{i,j} g_theta(o_i, o_j, q) )`
- **Converged Gate $\sigma(a_i^K)$:** `0.957` — *Promote 'A Simple Neural Network Module': unary=['attention', 'compositional', 'entity'], pairwise_synergy=0.38.*
- **Extracted Note:** Computes pairwise relational interactions g_theta(x_i, x_j, w) across all entity pairs (i, j) gated by attention masks and aggregates them via f_phi. Captures multi-entity compositional, spatial, and graph topology relations where independent unary entity encoders fail.

- **Relational Bridge ([[Pairwise Relational & Compositional Architectures]])** $\leftrightarrow$ [[Concept Learning with Energy-Based Models]]: Co-instantiates relational, pairwise, attention, compositional.
